items.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
items.content: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
items.contentSnippet: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.

summaries.zh: AI原生公司（如Basis、Clay和Exa Labs）将AI智能体嵌入工作流，用于优化客户入职、账户管理和开发者集成等环节，从而把日常流程转化为可复用的运营能力。文章指出，企业领导者可借鉴这一做法，通过AI代理提升效率与响应速度，实现从单点工具到系统性运营能力的转变。核心启示在于：将AI深度融入关键业务流程，而非仅作辅助。
summaries.en: AI-native companies such as Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs are using AI agents to transform key workflows into operational strengths. They focus on improving customer onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. These examples show how AI can streamline processes and enhance efficiency. Enterprise leaders can apply similar approaches to turn routine workflows into scalable operating capabilities. The key is integrating AI agents strategically into core business functions rather than treating them as isolated tools.

items.title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
items.content: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.
items.contentSnippet: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.

summaries.zh: Astra是OpenAI首个在《预备框架》下达到“关键网络安全能力”门槛的模型。该门槛是根据预备框架评估得出的，标志着其能力已达到关键水平。同时，OpenAI为Astra的发布配备了更强的安全防护措施，以确保其在具备高级能力的同时，能够更安全地部署和使用。
summaries.en: Astra is the first OpenAI model to reach the "Critical" cybersecurity capability threshold under the company’s Preparedness Framework. Because of this elevated capability level, OpenAI applied stronger safeguards before releasing the model. The announcement highlights both the model’s advanced security-related abilities and the increased protective measures taken to ensure responsible deployment.
